value.rationale: The 2026 primary literature singles out exact-size joint existence of these axioms as open even pairwise. A full three-way solution on two distinct, potentially overlapping approval ballots is a motivated structural positive domain; a quota-clamping rule differing between common-candidate and disjoint cases avoids the classic pure apportionment limitation. The claim is self-contained, constructive, with a sharp two-type scope and clear follow-on question for three ballot types.
